title: Kiro Hook Format
description: JSON Schema for Kiro hook configuration files (.kiro/hooks/*.json) - event-driven automations. Supports both file-based events (fileCreated, fileModified, fileDeleted) and lifecycle events (agentSpawn, userPromptSubmit, preToolUse, postToolUse, stop).

description.description: Explanation of what this hook does

when.description: Event trigger configuration. File events require patterns, lifecycle events do not.

type.description: Event type. File events: fileCreated (new files created), fileModified (files saved), fileDeleted (files removed). Lifecycle events: agentSpawn (agent activated), userPromptSubmit (user submits prompt), preToolUse (before tool execution, can block), postToolUse (after tool execution), stop (agent finishes responding).

patterns.description: Glob patterns to match files (required for file events, optional for lifecycle events)

then.description: Action to take when event occurs

command.description: Shell command for runCommand action type

examples.name: Auto Test Files
examples.description: Creates test files for new components

then.prompt: A new component was created. Create a corresponding test file.

examples.name: Lint on Save
examples.description: Runs linter when files are modified

examples.name: Session Setup
examples.description: Loads project context when agent starts

then.prompt: Read the README.md and CONTRIBUTING.md to understand the project structure and coding conventions.

examples.name: Security Check
examples.description: Reviews tool calls for security concerns

then.prompt: Review this tool call for potential security issues. Block if it accesses sensitive files or runs dangerous commands.
